metadata.title: The Art of War
metadata.creator: Sun Tzu
metadata.description:
Librivox recording of The Art of War by Sun Tzu, translated by Lionel Giles.
Read by Moira Fogarty.

"The Art of War is a Chinese military treatise written during the 6th century BC by Sun Tzu. Composed of 13 chapters, each of which is devoted to one aspect of warfare, it has long been praised as the definitive work on military strategies and tactics of its time. The Art of War is one of the oldest and most famous studies of strategy and has had a huge influence on both military planning and beyond. The Art of War has also been applied, with much success, to business and managerial strategies."
(summary from Wikipedia)

For more information on our readers, please visit the catalog page

For more free audiobooks, or to become a volunteer reader, please visit librivox.org. Download M4B (17MB)

Moira Fogarty has done an excellent job in presenting this work.  The sound quality itself is of the highest quality, however her enunciation and the timber of her voice, including her vocal range, makes this a pleasure to hear.

As Sun Tzu's Art of War can be a great temptation to make masculine, and authoritative Ms. Fogarty's straight forward and clear reading allows these ancient thoughts to enter the center of the consciousness.

If you're familiar with this work, her presentation is worth revisiting it for the pure enjoyment of the experience.  My compliments to Ms. Fogarty.

reviews.reviewtitle: The Art of War by Sun Tzu in audiobook
reviews.reviewbody: An absolute classic! Listening to The Art of War by Sun Tzu in audiobook format brings a new depth to the ancient wisdom it holds. The narrator does a great job keeping the tone serious and engaging, which is perfect for absorbing such strategic and philosophical insights. This timeless work isn’t just for military enthusiasts—it offers valuable lessons for leadership, business, and even personal discipline. If you're looking for something more lighthearted after diving into such intense material, take a breather with Doodle Baseball—a fun and nostalgic game to relax your mind. Great job, LibriVox and Internet Archive, for keeping these classics alive and accessible!

"The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting."
                                                                   - Sun Tzu
